title: RepForcing: Representation-Space Initialization for Autoregressive Video Distillation
title_zh: RepForcing：自回归视频蒸馏中的表示空间初始化

paragraphs.en: Distilling pretrained video diffusion models into few-step autoregressive (AR) generators typically combines student initialization with distribution matching distillation (DMD). An intermediate AR teacher can provide causally compatible targets for ODE initialization. However, causally compatible targets alone do not ensure high-quality generation under a short sampling schedule. We analyze the posterior-mean predictions favored by direct latent regression and empirically find that causal ODE initialization alleviates blur but still leaves fine detail unresolved. To address this limitation, we propose Representation Forcing , which learns few-step causal initialization through representation-space supervision rather than intermediate-teacher trajectory regression. The student is trained with teacher forcing by comparing clean predictions and training targets through normalized features of a frozen video diffusion transformer. This phase reuses the synthetic videos generated by a bidirectional model for AR teacher training and replaces both teacher training and causal ODE distillation, without generating additional causal ODE trajectories. The subsequent asymmetric DMD procedure remains unchanged. Empirical results show that, at four sampling steps, RepForcing better preserves generation quality than intermediate-teacher-based initialization before DMD. After DMD, our four-step chunk-wise model improves VBench Total from 84.04 to 84.66 (+0.62 points) and VisionReward from 6.326 to 10.074 (+59.25%) over the reported causal-ODE-based baseline. Code at RepForcing .
paragraphs.zh: 将预训练的视频扩散模型提炼为少数步数的自回归（AR）生成器时，通常会结合学生模型初始化和分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）。 一个中间 AR 教师模型可以为 ODE 初始化提供因果兼容的目标。 然而，仅凭因果兼容的目标无法确保在较短的采样方案下生成高质量结果。 我们分析了直接潜在回归所偏好的后验均值预测，并通过实证发现，因果 ODE 初始化虽然能减轻模糊问题，但仍无法解决细节不清晰的问题。 为解决这一局限性，我们提出了“表示强制”（Representation Forcing）方法，该方法通过表示空间监督而非中间教师轨迹回归来学习少数步数的因果初始化。 学生模型通过教师强制进行训练，即利用冻结的视频扩散变换器的归一化特征，将干净的预测结果与训练目标进行比较。 这一阶段重用了双向模型生成的合成视频用于 AR 教师训练，并取代了教师训练和因果 ODE 蒸馏两个步骤，同时无需生成额外的因果 ODE 轨迹。 随后的非对称 DMD 流程保持不变。 实证结果表明，在四步采样时，RepForcing 在 DMD 之前比基于中间教师的初始化方法更能保留生成质量。 经过 DMD 处理后，我们的四步分块模型在 VBench Total 上的得分从 84.04 提升至 84.66（+0.62 分），在 VisionReward 上的得分从 6.326 提升至 10.074（+59.25%），优于已报道的基于因果 ODE 的基线模型。代码见 RepForcing。

paragraphs.en: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion enables streaming generation by producing video blocks conditioned on previously generated content. This formulation supports interactive applications including world modeling, game simulation, and embodied intelligence ( Jin et al., 2025 ; Teng et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Ball et al., 2025 ) . Despite these capabilities, repeatedly denoising each block increases inference cost. Reducing the number of sampling steps while preserving visual quality is therefore important for real-time video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 自回归（AR）视频扩散模型通过根据先前生成的内容生成视频块，实现了流式生成。 这种形式支持交互式应用，包括世界建模、游戏模拟和具身智能（Jin et al., 2025；Teng et al., 2025；Chen et al., 2025；Ball et al., 2025）。 尽管具备这些能力，但反复对每个视频块进行去噪会增加推理成本。 因此，在保持视觉质量的同时减少采样步数，对于实时视频生成至关重要。

paragraphs.en: To reduce this cost, distillation methods ( Yin et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ) convert pretrained bidirectional video diffusion models into few-step AR students. The training pipeline typically consists of an initialization stage followed by asymmetric distribution matching distillation (DMD) ( Yin et al., 2024b ; Yin et al., 2024a ) . Beyond accelerating sampling, initialization must account for the difference between bidirectional teachers and causal students. Prior analysis ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) identifies frame-level injectivity as a requirement for recovering the teacher’s flow map through ODE distillation: each input available to the student must determine a unique endpoint. A bidirectional teacher can violate this requirement through its dependence on future frames unavailable to the student. Training an intermediate AR teacher and distilling its causal trajectories provides compatible targets, but requires two training stages before DMD.
paragraphs.zh: 为了降低这一成本，蒸馏方法（Yin 等，2025；Huang 等，2025）将预训练的双向视频扩散模型转化为少数步 AR 学生模型。 训练流程通常包括一个初始化阶段，随后进行非对称分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）（Yin 等，2024b；Yin 等，2024a）。 除了加速采样之外，初始化还必须考虑双向教师模型与因果学生模型之间的差异。 先前的分析（Zhu 等，2026）指出，帧级单射性是通过 ODE 蒸馏恢复教师模型流图的一项要求：学生模型可接收的每个输入都必须确定一个唯一的终点。 双向教师模型可能因其依赖学生模型无法获取的未来帧而违反这一要求。 训练一个中间 AR 教师模型并蒸馏其因果轨迹可以提供兼容的目标，但这需要在 DMD 之前进行两个训练阶段。

paragraphs.en: However, resolving causal compatibility does not by itself ensure high-quality few-step generation. In this work, we revisit the supervision used to construct the initialization. Direct latent regression favors posterior-mean clean predictions: when the noisy input and its conditions admit different plausible continuations, coordinate-wise averaging can blur texture and blend incompatible structures. This concerns individual clean predictions rather than the output distribution of a complete multi-step sampler. Empirically, directly shortening the sampling schedule of the teacher-forced AR diffusion model produces blurred outputs. Causal ODE initialization alleviates this blur, but still leaves fine detail unresolved under few-step sampling. Figure 2 compares the initialization methods as the number of sampling steps decreases, revealing a larger quality gap between ODE initialization and RepForcing at four steps. Thus, deterministic teacher targets do not remove the observed limitation. These findings motivate an alternative to intermediate-teacher initialization, rather than an additional distillation stage.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，解决因果兼容性本身并不能确保高质量的多步生成。 在本项工作中，我们重新审视了用于构建初始化的监督方法。 直接潜在回归倾向于产生后验均值干净的预测：当含噪输入及其条件允许不同的合理延续时，按坐标进行平均可能会模糊纹理并混合不兼容的结构。 这涉及单个干净的预测，而非完整多步采样器的输出分布。 经验表明，直接缩短教师强制自回归扩散模型的采样时间表会产生模糊的输出。 因果 ODE 初始化可以缓解这种模糊现象，但在少步采样下仍无法解决精细细节的问题。 图 2 比较了不同采样步数下的初始化方法，揭示了在四步采样时 ODE 初始化和 RepForcing 之间更大的质量差异。 因此，确定性教师目标并未消除所观察到的局限性。 这些发现促使我们提出一种替代中间教师初始化的方法，而非增加额外的蒸馏阶段。

paragraphs.en: To address this limitation, we propose Representation Forcing (RepForcing), which learns few-step causal initialization directly in a pretrained video representation space. The student predicts clean video blocks under teacher forcing, and its predicted video is compared with the training target through normalized features of a frozen video diffusion transformer. Unlike coordinate-wise latent regression, this objective need not favor the latent posterior mean. RepForcing preserves the causal student architecture and reuses the synthetic videos generated by a bidirectional Wan model from VidProM ( Wang and Yang, 2024 ) prompts for intermediate AR teacher training. It requires no additional causal ODE trajectory pairs. A single teacher-forced phase replaces both intermediate-teacher training and ODE distillation, after which the student undergoes the same asymmetric DMD refinement using its own generated prefixes.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了“表示强制”（RepForcing）方法，该方法直接在预训练的视频表示空间中学习少步因果初始化。 学生在教师强制下预测干净的视频块，并通过冻结视频扩散变换器的归一化特征，将其预测视频与训练目标进行比较。 与逐坐标的潜在回归不同，该目标函数不必偏向潜在后验均值。 RepForcing 保留了因果学生架构，并重新使用了由 VidProM（Wang and Yang, 2024）提示生成的双向 Wan 模型所合成的视频，用于中间 AR 教师训练。 它不需要任何额外的因果 ODE 轨迹对。 一个单次教师强制阶段取代了中间教师训练和 ODE 蒸馏，之后学生使用自身生成的前缀进行相同的非对称 DMD 优化。

Our analysis connects the posterior-mean behavior of latent regression to the loss of detail under a short sampling schedule, while controlled comparisons show that causal ODE initialization alleviates blur but leaves fine detail unresolved.

paragraphs.en: CausVid ( Yin et al., 2025 ) and Self Forcing initialize the AR student with ODE pairs from a bidirectional teacher before DMD ( Yin et al., 2024b ; Yin et al., 2024a ) . Causal Forcing ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) replaces this teacher with an AR model trained under teacher forcing, so that the distilled trajectories respect causality. Causal Forcing++ ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) and Causal-rCM ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) substitute causal consistency distillation or training for the trajectory stage, building on consistency models ( Song et al., 2023 ; Lu and Song, 2025 ) . All of these learn the few-step initialization from an intermediate multi-step teacher; we instead obtain it directly from the shared bidirectional-model-generated training videos by changing the regression metric.

paragraphs.en: Perceptual losses compare predictions and targets through a pretrained network ( Simonyan and Zisserman, 2014 ; Johnson et al., 2016 ) , and LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) calibrates such distances to human judgments. In generative modeling, REPA ( Yu et al., 2024 ) and Geometry Forcing ( Wu et al., 2026 ) align a generator’s internal activations with an external encoder such as DINOv2 ( Oquab et al., 2023 ) , REPA-E ( Leng et al., 2025 ) extends this alignment to end-to-end VAE tuning, representation autoencoders ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) perform diffusion in the space of a pretrained encoder, and LADD ( Sauer et al., 2024 ) uses diffusion features for adversarial distillation. Our objective differs from each of them: it preserves the generator architecture and VAE, requires no discriminator, and uses a frozen video DiT only to measure the distance between a predicted clean latent and its target.
paragraphs.zh: 感知损失通过预训练网络比较预测结果与目标（Simonyan 和 Zisserman，2014；Johnson 等，2016），而 LPIPS（Zhang 等，2018）则将这些距离校准到人类判断。 在生成式建模中，REPA（Yu 等，2024）和 Geometry Forcing（Wu 等，2026）将生成器的内部激活与外部编码器（如 DINOv2（Oquab 等，2023））对齐；REPA-E（Leng 等，2025）将这种对齐扩展到端到端 VAE 调优；表示自编码器（Zheng 等，2025）在预训练编码器的空间中执行扩散；而 LADD（Sauer 等，2024）则使用扩散特征进行对抗性蒸馏。 我们的目标与上述方法均有所不同：它保留生成器架构和 VAE，不需要判别器，并且仅使用冻结的视频 DiT 来测量预测的干净潜在变量与其目标之间的距离。

paragraphs.en: Proposition 1 shows that latent regression favors the conditional mean of clean continuations compatible with the noisy input and its conditions. When these continuations differ in texture placement or motion phase, coordinate-wise averaging can blend incompatible structures. Multi-step sampling refines successive predictions as noise decreases, whereas a short schedule provides fewer refinement steps. The proposition characterizes direct clean predictions, rather than the output distribution of the complete sampler. Empirically, the teacher-forced AR diffusion model produces blurred outputs under four-step sampling, indicating that diffusion training alone does not provide the required few-step initialization in this setting.
paragraphs.zh: 命题 1 表明，潜在回归倾向于选择与含噪输入及其条件兼容的干净续写序列的条件均值。 当这些续写序列在纹理布局或运动阶段上存在差异时，按坐标分量的平均操作可能会融合不兼容的结构。 多步采样会随着噪声的减少而逐步优化连续预测结果，而较短的采样流程则提供的优化步骤更少。 该命题描述的是直接的干净预测结果，而非完整采样器的输出分布。 从经验上看，在四步采样下，教师强制 AR 扩散模型会产生模糊的输出，这表明仅靠扩散训练在此设定下无法提供所需的少步初始化。

paragraphs.en: RepForcing’s representation-space initialization uses the shared synthetic dataset 𝒟 Bi \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{Bi}} defined in Sec. 3 . We use a Wan2.1-1.3B causal student, a frozen Wan2.1-14B feature extractor and DMD teacher, and a Wan2.1-1.3B auxiliary score model. Final models are evaluated with four-step generation in both chunk-wise and frame-wise settings, using three latent frames per chunk in the former. Each model is refined with its corresponding four-step DMD rollout schedule. paragraphs.en: In this work, we examine the limitations of intermediate-teacher initialization for few-step autoregressive video generation. Our analysis links latent regression to posterior-mean predictions, while experiments reveal that causal ODE initialization still leaves fine detail unresolved under few-step sampling. Motivated by these findings, we propose Representation Forcing, which supervises the causal student’s clean predictions through normalized features of a frozen video diffusion transformer. A single teacher-forced phase on the same synthetic training videos replaces intermediate-teacher training and causal ODE distillation, followed by asymmetric DMD. Experiments show that RepForcing better preserves generation quality than intermediate-teacher-based initialization at four sampling steps before DMD. After DMD, it achieves higher VBench Total and VisionReward than the reported Causal Forcing baselines in both chunk-wise and frame-wise generation, without additional causal ODE trajectory generation.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们探讨了中间教师初始化在少步自回归视频生成中的局限性。 我们的分析将潜在回归与后验均值预测联系起来，而实验表明，在少步采样下，因果 ODE 初始化仍然无法解决细节问题。 基于这些发现，我们提出了“表示强制”（Representation Forcing）方法，通过冻结的视频扩散变换器的归一化特征来监督因果学生模型的纯净预测。 在相同的合成训练视频上执行一次教师强制阶段，即可替代中间教师训练和因果 ODE 蒸馏，随后再进行非对称 DMD。 实验表明，在 DMD 之前的四个采样步骤中，“表示强制”比基于中间教师的初始化更能保留生成质量。 经过 DMD 后，无论是在分块生成还是帧级生成中，它都实现了高于已报道的“因果强制”基线方法的 VBench Total 和 VisionReward，且无需额外的因果 ODE 轨迹生成。

sents.en: Motivated by these findings, we propose Representation Forcing, which supervises the causal student’s clean predictions through normalized features of a frozen video diffusion transformer.
sents.zh: 基于这些发现，我们提出了“表示强制”（Representation Forcing）方法，通过冻结的视频扩散变换器的归一化特征来监督因果学生模型的纯净预测。

sents.en: A single teacher-forced phase on the same synthetic training videos replaces intermediate-teacher training and causal ODE distillation, followed by asymmetric DMD.
sents.zh: 在相同的合成训练视频上执行一次教师强制阶段，即可替代中间教师训练和因果 ODE 蒸馏，随后再进行非对称 DMD。

sents.en: Experiments show that RepForcing better preserves generation quality than intermediate-teacher-based initialization at four sampling steps before DMD.
sents.zh: 实验表明，在 DMD 之前的四个采样步骤中，“表示强制”比基于中间教师的初始化更能保留生成质量。

sents.en: After DMD, it achieves higher VBench Total and VisionReward than the reported Causal Forcing baselines in both chunk-wise and frame-wise generation, without additional causal ODE trajectory generation.
sents.zh: 经过 DMD 后，无论是在分块生成还是帧级生成中，它都实现了高于已报道的“因果强制”基线方法的 VBench Total 和 VisionReward，且无需额外的因果 ODE 轨迹生成。

paragraphs.en: RepForcing’s Stage 1 reuses Causal Forcing’s first-stage 𝒟 Bi \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{Bi}} , consisting of approximately 3K clean video samples synthesized by a bidirectional Wan model from VidProM prompts ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) . These offline samples supply both the clean targets and teacher-forcing prefixes. They are neither real captured videos nor the student’s online self-rollouts used during DMD. Causal Forcing additionally generates causal ODE trajectory pairs with its trained AR teacher; RepForcing does not use that second dataset. Although Causal Forcing stores bidirectional noisy intermediates when constructing 𝒟 Bi \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{Bi}} for an ODE baseline, RepForcing needs only the clean video samples and independently adds noise during training.

paragraphs.en: The RepForcing samples show distinct orange segments and clothing folds in the indoor scene, together with snow texture and mountain contours in the fjord scene.
